name: Six Senses Douro Valley
positioning: A restored 19th-century hilltop manor above the Douro river, with rooms, suites and villas among kitchen gardens and vineyards
best_for: Wine lovers who want vineyard views and hands-on winemaking
Travelers seeking a spa retreat in the Douro Valley

facts.text: The resort is at Quinta de Vale Abraao in Samodaes, Lamego.
The manor has been restored with contemporary interiors reflecting the region's heritage.
Contemporary decor blends with natural materials and Portuguese design.
Rooms, suites and villas are set within kitchen gardens and vineyards.
Rooms have vineyard views from huge windows.
The spa offers locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion.
Activities include a gourmet river cruise and visits to historic wineries.
The resort's Forest Restoration Project nurses its parkland back to health as a home for soil fertility, fungi, insects and birds.
Douro Valley vintages can be tasted with guidance from the resort's sommelier.
Dining uses homegrown vegetables and herbs and fresh produce from the valley.

highlights.text: The 19th-century manor sits high on a hill overlooking vine-covered terraces, with the Douro river at its feet.
Guests can be winemaker for a day and go grape stomping in season.
Rooms have vineyard views from huge windows.
The spa offers locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to reach Porto city center.
